Rashi on Arakhin 15b:13:1.hebrew: אותו לא אוכל - בהאי קרא דכתיב לעיל מיניה כתיב "מלשני בסתר רעהו":
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:13:1.english: "Oto lo uchal" ["I will not suffer him"] - In this same verse, earlier, it is written: "Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret":

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:13:2.hebrew: על גסי הרוח - מתני לה להא דרב חסדא, דבהאי קרא דאותו לא אוכל כתיב נמי "גבה עינים":
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:13:2.english: On the arrogant - [they teach] this statement of Rav Chisda [as referring to them], because in this very verse, "I will not suffer him," "haughty of eye" is also written:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:14:1.english: “We will judge him” - this is the text we read.

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:16:1.hebrew: וסלף בה - מי שסולף בה, וחפץ לסלקה שלא תהא בו עוד, ישבור רוחו:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:16:1.english: "And its perverseness [is] in it" - One who perverts [his tongue] with it, and wishes to remove it [the perverseness] so that it will no longer be in him, should break his spirit:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:17:1.english: Has cut him off - [This is] an expression of *karet* [excision]:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:1:1.english: Do not go out - on Shabbat to gather [manna]:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:20:1.hebrew: הי מינייהו מפקא - הא בכולהו עבירות כתיב "גדולות", הלכך כולהו אתו:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:20:1.english: Which of them would you take out? - Behold, with regard to all of them [the transgressions] the word "great things" is written; therefore, all of them come [to be included]:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:21:1.hebrew: לישנא תליתאי - זה לשון הרכיל, שהיא שלישית בין אדם לחבירו, לגלות לו סוד:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:21:1.english: "Third speech" - This is the language of a talebearer, which is a third [party] between a person and his fellow, to reveal a secret to him:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:21:2.hebrew: לאומרו - הורג לרכיל עצמו, שמתוך מריבה שנופלת בין השנים הורגין זה את זה, והורגין גואלי הדם את הרכיל, שההרג בא על ידו:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:21:2.english: And the one who says it - [it kills] the talebearer himself, for as a result of the quarrel that falls between the two [parties], they kill one another, and the avengers of blood kill the talebearer, since the killing came about through him:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:25:1.hebrew: דבעי מיית בלישניה - יעסוק בדברי שטות ונבלה:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:25:1.english: One who wants to die, [can do so] by his tongue - [by] engaging in foolish and vile speech:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:25:2.hebrew: דבעי חיי בלישניה - יזכה לחיים על ידי לשונו, כשהוא יעסוק בתורה:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:25:2.english: One who wants life through his tongue - [he can attain it when] he engages in Torah study:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:26:1.hebrew: נורא בי פלניא - דמשמע עשיר הוא, וכל שעה מצוי אש בביתו לבשל תבשילין:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:26:1.english: Fire at so-and-so's house - For this implies that he is wealthy, and at every hour there is fire to be found in his house for cooking dishes:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:26:2.hebrew: גלויי מילתא בעלמא הוא - הואיל ואינו אומרה בלשון הרע, אלא מגלה לאותן שמבקשין אור: לכו לבית פלוני:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:26:2.english: It is merely revealing a fact - Since he does not say it in a slanderous manner, but [only] reveals [it] to those who are looking for fire: Go to so-and-so's house:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:27:1.hebrew: דמיתאמרא באפי מרה - שהמרגל אומרה בפני האומר עליו:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:27:1.english: That is said in the presence of its master - [This refers to a case] where the slanderer says it in the presence of the one about whom it is said:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:27:2.hebrew: וחזרתי לאחורי - לראות מי יעמוד אחורי, שאף בפני הבעלים אני אומרה. אלמא לאו לישנא בישא חשיבא. ל"א: שאם באו הבעלים ואמרו "למה אמרת כן?", לא חזרתי בי מדברי, לאמר "לא אמרתי", אלא בפניהם הודיתי:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:27:2.english: And I turned around - to see who was standing behind me, [for] I say it even in the presence of the person involved. Evidently, [such speech] is not considered malicious speech. Another explanation: If the people involved came and said, "Why did you say so?", I would not retract [my words] by saying, "I did not say [it]," but would acknowledge [it] in their presence:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:2:1.hebrew: בשליו ראשון - כשהתחיל המן לירד, היה שליו יורד עמו, כדכתיב (שמות טז): ויהי בערב ותעל השליו וגו', ובבקר היתה שכבת הטל וגו'. ולאחר זמן מרובה התאוו יותר:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:2:1.english: With the first quail - When the manna began to descend, quail descended along with it, as it is written (Exodus 16): "And it came to pass in the evening that the quail came up, etc., and in the morning there was a layer of dew, etc." And after a long time, they craved [meat] even more:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:4:1.english: In the wilderness of Paran - [This refers to] the incident of the spies:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:5:2.hebrew: מה יתן לך ומה יוסיף לך - עוד הקדוש ברוך הוא שמירה, שלא תספר לשון הרע:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:5:2.english: What shall be given to you, and what more shall be done for you - What more [could] the Holy One, Blessed be He, [provide as] a safeguard, so that you will not speak malicious speech?

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:6:1.hebrew: האומרים ללשוננו נגביר - כמי שאומר הכתוב "מי אדון לנו", דכופרים בעיקר:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:6:1.english: Those who say, "We will make our tongue mighty" - [are considered] like one who says [as the verse continues], "Who is lord over us," for they deny the fundamental [belief]:

Rashi on Arakhin 15b:8:1.hebrew: למצורע מוחלט - אלמא שהלשון אצמית שהוא דמתרגם אותו לשון חליטה, היינו צרעת:
Rashi on Arakhin 15b:8:1.english: A confirmed [muchlat] leper - Evidently, [the term] "atzmit" [in the verse], which [Targum] translates as an expression of "chalita" [being fixed or confirmed], refers to leprosy:

Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:21:1.hebrew: לישנא תליתאי - פרש"י: לשון שלישי של רכיל מגלה סוד. ואני מצאתי כתוב: לישנא תליתאי, שהקיפה הקב"ה אחת של עצם ואחת של בשר, והוא שלישי בתוכם:
Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:21:1.english: Third speech - Rashi explained: [It means] the third speech of a talebearer who reveals a secret. But I found it written: "Third speech" [is so called] because the Holy One, blessed be He, surrounded [the tongue] with one [wall] of bone and one of flesh, and it [the tongue] is the third among them:

Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:2:1.hebrew: התאוו תאוה - פרש"י: התאוו יותר, משמע שלא פסק להם השליו, רש"י. והר"ר יוסף קרא פירש, שפסק להם השליו ראשון, והאספסוף אשר בקרבו התאוו תאוה, לפי שלא היה להם שליו, וירד להם שליו שני:
Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:2:1.english: They craved a craving - Rashi explained: "They craved more," which implies that the quail had not ceased for them. [So writes] Rashi. And Rabbi Yosef Kara explained that the first quail had ceased for them, and "the mixed multitude that was among them craved a craving" because they had no quail, and a second quail came down for them:

Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:9:1.hebrew: ואמר ריש לקיש מאי דכתיב זאת תהיה תורת המצורע תורת מוציא שם רע - "אמר" גרסינן, ולא גרסי' "ואמר", דהא ריש לקיש לא אמר כלל לעיל:
Tosafot on Arakhin 15b:9:1.english: "And Reish Lakish said: What is [the meaning of] that which is written, 'This shall be the law of the leper' — the law of a defamer" - We read "[Reish Lakish] said," and we do not read "and [Reish Lakish] said," for Reish Lakish did not say anything earlier at all:
